executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Execution and completion evidence were inconsistent across wrappers and GUI backends.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Host-side evidence admission and actual supported tool contracts.

findings.title: Unsupported operational speech could be presented as success
findings.mechanism: Provider audio was admitted independently of current-turn tool completion.
findings.source_layer: tool interpretation / answer delivery / memory admission
findings.root_cause: No host-side evidence gate for recognized operational turns.
findings.recommended_fix: Withhold ungrounded operational audio; use truthful local failure, pending, confirmation or authorization feedback.

findings.title: Failure and admission receipts could become completed work
findings.mechanism: Adapter and SDK flag dialects, cached legacy results and quoted status strings lost their meaning.
findings.root_cause: Permissive receipt conversion across wrapper boundaries.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve explicit failures, uncertainty and pending states without replaying actions.

findings.title: GUI bridge used an unsupported driver action and incomplete target identity
findings.mechanism: click_window is absent from the installed driver; window targets also needed PID and correct coordinate space.
findings.root_cause: Invented driver contract and missing compositor identity binding.
findings.recommended_fix: Use supported exact-target APIs; use native input only after explicit admission refusal, with current target checks.

findings.title: Declared platform tools had no matching handlers
findings.mechanism: Two Composio registry method names did not resolve to domain implementations.
findings.recommended_fix: Connect the actual handlers and test dispatch through the registry.

findings.title: Workflow cutoff and inconsistent timeouts interrupted authorized work
findings.mechanism: The sixth voice call stopped even successful work; domain routing imposed a shorter deadline.
findings.root_cause: Fixed five-success budget and duplicated timeout policy.
findings.recommended_fix: Allow bounded multi-step execution and share deadline selection; cancel and reap subprocesses.

findings.title: State verifiers accepted incomplete or failed observations
findings.mechanism: Failed inventory reads could imply closure; ambiguous windows and partial clipboard text could pass.
findings.root_cause: Treating missing observations as negative facts and partial content as complete proof.
findings.recommended_fix: Require successful exact observations and reject ambiguity.

findings.title: Literal typing was intermittently incomplete
findings.mechanism: The real test field sometimes received incomplete replacement text under the prior injector.
findings.root_cause: Small temporary keymaps and native client keycode interpretation were unsafe for reliable literal delivery.
findings.recommended_fix: Use a stable complete map and conventional physical codes, then verify the application field.

ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Failed and unfinished work stays incomplete

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Repair actual GUI and service adapters
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Advertised tools must resolve to real implementations
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Supported native effects can be observed

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Verify packaged runtime and preserve current user state
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Checkout tests alone do not prove installed behavior
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Scoped release with health checks and rollback

running_service_timing_scope: Each recorded roundtrip includes one query and a duplicate receipt request.
remaining_limits: Conservative speech patterns and tool receipts are not formal verification of every natural-language goal.
Successful wrong-tool selection, ambiguous app state, unrecognized phrasing and model-generated narration remain possible error sources.
External services still need valid credentials, permissions and user-completed authorization.
Arbitrary account mutations and outbound communications were not live-tested.
Optional CLI-Hub executables are absent; platform-specific app accessibility can vary.
